purpose: Teach: 伴わ/望め/不運/奨め/ドンドン/浮かび上がっ/不機嫌/塗る

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、弟を伴わずに遊びに行くな
lines.en: Riku, don't go out without bringing your brother along.
lines.style: Firm older-sibling tone, no negotiation. Direct eye contact. Said like a rule, not a suggestion. Slight edge underneath—she means this.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、テストで合格を望めるか、桜?
lines.en: Do you think you'll pass the test, Sakura?
lines.style: Genuine, slightly uncertain question. Soft vocal attack. Not defensive—actually wondering. A small hesitation before her name, like he's checking if it's safe to ask.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、不運続きだな
lines.en: Riku, you really have been hitting a rough patch lately, haven't you.
lines.style: Wry observation, half-teasing. Said like she's noticing something he probably doesn't want noticed. Tone stays light but there's care underneath the sarcasm.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、新作ゲーム奨めてくれよ、桜
lines.en: Hey, recommend me a new game, would you Sakura?
lines.style: Casual, almost deflecting. Lighter vocal tone—a subject change. Reaches for normalcy the way you might reach for your phone. Still asking her though, which means something.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、ドンドン強くなってるな
lines.en: Riku, you've been getting stronger and stronger lately.
lines.style: Genuine praise, slightly surprised at her own sincerity. Warm attack on the opening word. Not showy—just noticing something real about him. A small smile in the voice.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、テストの答えが頭に浮かび上がっただろ?桜
lines.en: The test answers just popped into your head, didn't they Sakura?
lines.style: Teasing but not mean. Light, almost playful. Catching her in a moment of competence. Quick pace, like he's enjoying this small observation.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、お前、最近不機嫌だな
lines.en: Riku, you've seemed kind of down recently.
lines.style: Softly curious, no accusation. Genuine concern masked by casual delivery. Slower pace on the observation. She's checking in, careful not to poke too hard.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お前、ペンキで看板を塗る手伝いしたな、桜
lines.en: You helped paint that sign with me, remember Sakura?
lines.style: Warm acknowledgment, slightly surprised gratitude. Soft vocal attack. He's bringing back a small good moment they shared. Quiet fondness in the memory.
